title: Тест уровня B2–C1
description: 43 вопроса: грамматика и Use of English, словарь, идиомы, регистр и два коротких текста. Вопросы идут от уверенного B2 к C1. Результат: 0–17 — B2; 18–28 — уверенный B2 и переход к C1; 29–36 — C1; 37–43 — сильный C1 и выше.

questions.text: If I ___ you, I would accept the offer.
questions.explanation: Условное предложение 2-го типа: в нереальном условии после if используется were (If I were you…).

questions.text: She suggested ___ the meeting until next week.
questions.explanation: После suggest идёт -ing (suggested postponing) или that-клауза, но не инфинитив с to.

questions.text: By the time we arrived, the film ___.
questions.explanation: Действие произошло раньше другого действия в прошлом (arrived) — Past Perfect.

questions.text: I'd rather you ___ smoke in here.
questions.explanation: После I'd rather + подлежащее используется Past Simple, когда речь о настоящем или будущем: I'd rather you didn't.

questions.text: He's the man ___ car was stolen last week.
questions.explanation: Whose выражает принадлежность: чья машина.

questions.text: The report ___ by Friday, so please don't worry.
questions.explanation: Будущее совершённое пассивное: отчёт будет закончен к пятнице (will have been finished).

questions.text: I wish I ___ more time to prepare yesterday.
questions.explanation: Сожаление о прошлом: wish + Past Perfect (had had).

questions.text: You ___ have seen him at the party — he was in Paris that week.
questions.explanation: Невозможность в прошлом: can't have + V3 (не мог видеть).

questions.text: She apologised ___ late.
questions.explanation: После apologise for идёт -ing: apologised for being late.

questions.text: Not until I got home ___ that I'd lost my keys.
questions.explanation: После Not until в начале предложения — инверсия: did I realise.

questions.text: The film was so boring that I ___ asleep.
questions.explanation: Nearly + Past Simple: чуть не заснул.

questions.text: Could you ___ me a favour?
questions.explanation: Устойчивое сочетание: do someone a favour.

questions.text: I'm afraid I can't ___ up with his behaviour any longer.
questions.explanation: Фразовый глагол put up with — мириться, терпеть.

questions.text: We need to ___ the problem before it gets worse.
questions.explanation: Tackle a problem — взяться за решение проблемы.

questions.text: Despite ___ hard, she failed the exam.
questions.explanation: После despite — -ing или существительное, без of.

questions.text: Hardly ___ the building when the alarm went off.
questions.explanation: После Hardly в начале предложения — инверсия и Past Perfect: Hardly had we entered…

questions.text: I'd have called you if I ___ your number.
questions.explanation: Условное предложение 3-го типа: if + Past Perfect, would have + V3.

questions.text: It's high time you ___ about your future.
questions.explanation: It's high time + Past Simple: давно пора подумать.

questions.text: The new law is expected ___ into force next month.
questions.explanation: Конструкция is expected + to + V: ожидается, что закон вступит в силу.

questions.text: She is said ___ five languages.
questions.explanation: Конструкция is said + to + V: говорят, что она знает пять языков.

questions.text: Neither the manager nor the employees ___ aware of the change.
questions.explanation: При neither…nor глагол согласуется с ближайшим подлежащим (employees — множественное): were.

questions.text: Had it not been for your help, we ___ the deadline.
questions.explanation: Инверсия вместо if в условном 3-го типа: Had it not been for… — would have + V3.

questions.text: He insisted ___ paying for the meal.
questions.explanation: Insist on + -ing.

questions.text: I'm not used to ___ so early.
questions.explanation: Be used to + -ing: не привык вставать.

questions.text: The task proved far ___ difficult than we had expected.
questions.explanation: Сравнительная степень с усилением far: far more difficult than.

questions.text: The plane failed to ___ off because of the fog.
questions.explanation: Take off — взлетать.

questions.text: He showed great ___ in difficult circumstances.
questions.explanation: После great нужно существительное: determination.

questions.text: Under no circumstances ___ the door open.
questions.explanation: После Under no circumstances — инверсия: should you leave.

questions.text: The more you practise, ___ you will become.
questions.explanation: Конструкция the more…, the more…: the more fluent.

questions.text: The house, ___ roof was damaged in the storm, has been repaired.
questions.explanation: Whose + существительное: чья крыша.

questions.text: He denied ___ the money.
questions.explanation: После deny — -ing: denied taking.

questions.text: Little ___ she know that a surprise party was being prepared.
questions.explanation: После Little в начале предложения — инверсия: Little did she know…

questions.text: It's not worth crying over spilt ___.
questions.explanation: Идиома crying over spilt milk — переживать о том, что уже не исправить.

questions.text: I'm feeling a bit under the ___ today.
questions.explanation: Идиома under the weather — нездоровится.

questions.text: To ___ the ice at the party, he told a joke.
questions.explanation: Идиома break the ice — разрядить обстановку.

questions.text: Which sentence is the most formal?
options: Just wanted to check out the job thing.
I'm writing to ask about the job.
I am writing to enquire about the vacancy.
Can you tell me about the job?
questions.explanation: Формальный регистр: полные формы (I am), enquire и vacancy вместо ask и job.

questions.text: She has a reputation ___ being very strict.
questions.explanation: Reputation for + -ing.

questions.text: He didn't turn up. He ___ the message.
questions.explanation: Логичный вывод о прошлом: can't have got — вероятно, не получил.

questions.text: I wish you ___ so loudly; I'm trying to concentrate.
questions.explanation: Wish + would выражает раздражение чужим поведением в настоящем.

questions.text: The explanation was so ___ that nobody could understand it.
questions.explanation: Convoluted — запутанный: именно поэтому никто не понял. Остальные слова означают «чёткий, ясный».

questions.text: It's ___ that prices will rise again next year.
questions.explanation: Inevitable — неизбежный; остальные слова по смыслу не подходят.

questions.text: The museum's director, who has been in post for only six months, has already announced sweeping changes, much to the dismay of long-serving staff. How do the long-serving staff feel?
questions.explanation: Much to the dismay of — к огорчению (долго работающих сотрудников).

questions.text: Contrary to popular belief, goldfish can remember things for months. What do many people believe about goldfish?
options: They live for a very long time.
questions.explanation: Contrary to popular belief — вопреки распространённому мнению: люди думают, что у рыбок короткая память.
